establishes: bound-object (util.Moniker) services and the methods the client calls on them, derived from client bytecode

moniker_local_api.note: uppercase attributes handled locally by Moniker / MachoObjectConnection, therefore not remote methods; derived from the client, not hardcoded

derived_second_level.note: uppercase attribute taken on the RESULT of a bound call. Suggestive, not evidence: the result may be plain data. Not included in the headline totals.

promoted_names.note: the load-bearing heuristic: names allowed to carry taint across module boundaries because the name occurs in exactly one module of the whole tree. Audit this list.

rules.accessor_unique_name: function name defined in exactly one module of the tree
rules.accessor_by_module: receiver identified exactly, by import alias or sm.GetService(name)
rules.attribute: STORE_ATTR target in exactly one module
rules.container: moniker stored at a fixed index of a list/tuple attribute, read back by that same index
